identity.name: Respondr
principles: Clarity over Style: In a crisis, clarity is the only aesthetic that matters.
Calm Authority: Use blue/slate tones to lower heart rate. No panic reds.
Step-by-Step: Never overwhelm. Reveal information progressively.
Human Touch: The AI should feel like a calm expert, not a robot.

primary.description: Royal Blue - Used for primary actions and brand identity. Trustworthy.

secondary.description: Soft Blue - Used for backgrounds of secondary elements.

destructive.description: Red - Use SPARINGLY. Only for 'Account Compromised' confirmation or critical warnings.

images.description: Abstract floating blue glass shield element for hero section background or visual anchor.
Green and silver padlock for 'Prevention' or 'Security Tips' section.
Red and Blue security signs for 'Incident Types' or 'Warning' visuals.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. THEME SETUP: Update tailwind.config.js with the 'Soft Utility' color palette defined above. Use Slate-50 for background, not pure white.
2. FONT SETUP: Import 'Manrope' and 'Inter' from Google Fonts in index.css.
3. LANDING PAGE: Build a 'Calm Command Center'. Big, reassuring headline. Below it, a grid of 'Incident Cards' (Instagram, Gmail, etc.). Do not use a generic SaaS hero.

4. CHATBOT: The chat interface is the core. It must look like a modern messaging app (iMessage/WhatsApp style) but cleaner. Use 'ChatBubble' components with distinct styles for User (Blue) and AI (Gray).
5. RECOVERY LINKS: When the AI suggests a link, render it as a 'Verified Action Card' - a distinct UI element with a green checkmark, the official logo, and a 'Go to Official Support' button.
6. TRUST SIGNALS: Everywhere a link is shown, add a 'Verified by Respondr' tooltip or badge.
7. ACCESSIBILITY: Ensure all text has high contrast (Slate-600+ on Slate-50). No faint gray text.
8. DATA-TESTID: Add data-testid to every button, input, and card. E.g., 'incident-card-instagram', 'chat-input-field'.
universal_guidelines: Avoid 'AI Slop': No generic centered layouts. Use asymmetry in the landing page grid.
Micro-interactions: Buttons should scale down slightly on click. Cards should lift on hover.
Glassmorphism: Use the 'glass' utility defined in colors for sticky headers and overlays.
No Emojis: Use Lucide icons instead of emojis for a professional look.
Toast Notifications: Use 'sonner' for all system feedback.
